description.text:
The deck that won the Masters Division of the 2015 World Championships, built on Blastoise and Keldeo-EX, with Archie's Ace in the Hole to bring Blastoise out. The 2015 World Championships were held at the Hynes Convention Center in Boston, Massachusetts, from 21 to 23 August 2015, and drew more than 5,000 visitors from over 36 countries.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2015 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
